title: Formal user acceptance checklist and local guards

forbiddenInLocalGuard: Do not call Ozon Seller APIs.

existingTestAudit.currentCoverage: Mostly string checks for menu routes, registered view files, and endpoint names.
existingTestAudit.experienceGap: Does not prove that a seller can complete the workflow or understand the result.

existingTestAudit.currentCoverage: Checks that important labels and helper names remain in source files.
existingTestAudit.experienceGap: Does not prove layout, clickability, modal behavior, or real error display in a browser.

existingTestAudit.currentCoverage: Checks guard strings and confirmation code without executing Ozon, AI, stock, or order writes.
existingTestAudit.experienceGap: Does not prove external provider success; formal acceptance must use an authorized test store.

acceptanceSteps: Open 商品管理 in an authorized test store with products that have 商品图片 main and gallery images.
Click a product image in the list and verify the full gallery opens in an enlarged preview.
Open the edit drawer and verify the main image and gallery images also open in enlarged preview.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of the list image preview overlay.
Screenshot of the edit drawer gallery preview.

mustContain: 点击图片可放大查看图册

acceptanceSteps: Open 商品管理 with products covering visible, ready, attention, moderation failed, and inactive states.
Verify tabs and row tags show Chinese operator labels instead of raw Ozon enum text.
Hover or inspect the status and verify raw Ozon status remains available as diagnostic context.
manualEvidence: Screenshot showing Chinese status tabs and row status tags.
Screenshot or note showing raw Ozon status in diagnostic context.

acceptanceSteps: Open the edit drawer for a product that already has category ids returned by Ozon.
Wait for the category tree to load and verify the current category is preselected.
Change category and verify description_category_id/type_id are preserved in the form before saving.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of the drawer with current category and category id visible.
Note of the product offer_id and selected description_category_id.

acceptanceSteps: Open the product edit drawer for a product with stock.
Verify stock is shown as context only and the copy sends operators to 库存管理 for changes.
Verify there is no editable stock field in the product drawer.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of the stock context alert in the product drawer.
Confirmation that no stock input is present in the product edit form.

mustContain: 库存和仓库请到库存管理修改

acceptanceSteps: Open 采集箱 with at least one failed collection item.
Verify the row shows a failed state and an operator-readable reason.
Open the edit drawer and verify the same failure reason remains visible before retry.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of a failed row with reason visible.
Screenshot of the drawer failure alert.

acceptanceSteps: Open 上架记录 with failed, processing, and partial-success listing tasks.
Verify task_id, canonical status, Chinese detail, raw Ozon error, and translated message are visible.
Open task detail and verify errors_json is still inspectable before retry.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of listing rows with task id/status/error.
Screenshot of task detail with raw and Chinese Ozon errors.

mustContain: 部分商品需处理后重试

acceptanceSteps: In 库存管理, attempt to submit all stock drafts and verify explicit confirmation appears before Ozon stock submission.
Trigger a stock conflict fixture or authorized test case and verify overwrite confirmation appears.
In 订单管理, select shippable orders and verify irreversible batch shipment confirmation appears.
Verify cancelled orders cannot be selected for dangerous shipping actions.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of stock conflict overwrite confirmation.
Screenshot of batch shipment confirmation and cancelled-order disabled state.

mustContain: 确定将 ${drafts.value.length} 条库存草稿提交到 Ozon？
发现 Ozon 实时库存冲突
将对 ${eligible.length} 个订单执行不可逆的发货操作
Ozon 已接收发货，但本地库存更新失败

acceptanceSteps: Open AI 套图 without running generation and verify default provider and fallback order are visible.
Use a mocked/local failed response or authorized non-billable test to verify provider attempts and failure reason are shown.
Verify history shows the provider used for completed records.
manualEvidence: Screenshot of default provider and fallback order.
Screenshot of visible provider failure reason/attempt chain.

mustContain: TokenDun 失败，切换备用供应商
